UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Stores user-specific settings and preferences, linked to an external authentication system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the UserProfile entity, typically provided by an external authentication system.

role.description: The user's role in the system (e.g., 'user', 'admin').

prayerCalculationMethod.description: The preferred method for calculating daily prayer times (e.g., 'MuslimWorldLeague', 'ISNA').

madhab.description: The user's preferred Madhab (school of thought) for prayer time adjustments (e.g., 'Hanafi', 'Shafii').

latitude.description: The geographical latitude of the user's location, used for prayer time calculations.

longitude.description: The geographical longitude of the user's location, used for prayer time calculations.

timezone.description: The user's local timezone (e.g., 'America/New_York'), crucial for displaying correct prayer times.

preferredLanguage.description: The user's preferred language for translations.

preferredLanguageId.description: The internal ID for the preferred translation language.

Reciter.title: Reciter
Reciter.description: Represents a Quran reciter with metadata for the scholarly audio index.

reciter_name.description: The full name of the reciter.

nodeId.description: The specific infrastructure node handling this audio signal.

Video.title: Video
Video.description: Represents a scholarly video from a verified YouTube channel.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Video entity.

title.description: The title of the video lecture.

url.description: The YouTube URL of the video.

author.description: The scholar or speaker delivering the lecture.

UserBookmark.title: UserBookmark
UserBookmark.description: Stores a user's bookmark for a specific piece of content.

UserNote.title: UserNote
UserNote.description: Stores personal notes added by a user to specific content passages.

definition.description: Stores user-specific settings. Profile ID matches User ID.
Publicly readable reciters for the audio index.
